identificationModule.officialTitle: One-center, Open-label, Single-arm Clinical Study of the Safety and Effectiveness of NKG2D CAR-T Cells Infusion in the Treatment of Relapsed/ Refractory NKG2DL+ Tumors

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this study,the enrollment of the patients must meet the inclusion and exclusion criteria . All subjects will be asked to continue to undergo long-term gene safety follow-up.

primaryOutcomes.measure: The occurrence of AEs and SAEs during the study treatment
primaryOutcomes.description: An adverse event is any undesirable experience associated with the use of a medical product in a patient

secondaryOutcomes.description: overall survival refers to the period from being included in the test group to death caused by any reason
